From C-Moon · Price: gravity points away from you, so it pushes allies near you too.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: creatures and loose objects within 10 ft are pushed 5 ft away from you, allies included (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 5: Surge: a creature your stand hits turns inside out: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 9: Push 10 ft, and you can walk on walls.
  • 13: Emanation 20 ft.
  • 17: Surge: a target that fails the inside-out save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
